positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Created Excel Macros to automate customer data formatting. Used Microsoft Access to manage a database of over two years of sales data from 15+ retailer groups. Automated a PDF report generator for store-level sales analysis. Maintained a Power BI web display that gave visuals to given sales data. Wrote data queries in SQL, Power Query, and VBA.

positions.title: Lead Makerspace Technician
positions.description: Rose to the challenge of becoming a managerial figure in organization. Conducted scheduled consultations with patrons and taught them computer aided design, 3D printing, and other concepts. Collaborated with Makerspace Coordinator to support improvement initiatives and promote new technology. Formulated a curriculum that coincided with the makerspace technology, showcasing its abilities and instructing client use.

positions.title: Makerspace Technician
positions.description: Assembled and performed maintenance on multiple 3D printing systems (Prusa, Fusion, Monoprice, & Lulzbot). Assisted patrons with the use of a variety of software (CAD, video and audio editing, & adobe creative suite). Fostered the use of makerspace resources by promoting services in campus advertisements and curating a welcoming environment. Pioneered a PLA plastic recycling system that created 3D printer filament from scrap plastic
